title: Guided Clear Kayak Tours on the Silver River
includes: Clear Tandem Kayak with dry bag and paddles
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Attention wildlife enthusiasts! Embark on a thrilling kayaking adventure along the spring fed Silver River with a knowledgeable guide who will provide insightful commentary throughout your journey. To maximize your underwater visibility and enhance your chances of spotting diverse wildlife, you'll paddle in a 100% crystal clear kayak. Along with breathtaking scenery, you might encounter an array of wildlife including fish, manatees, monkeys, and various bird species.

Here's what you can expect:

Guided Exploration: Discover the wonders of the Silver River with an expert guide who will safely take you and the family or friends to Hollywood film icon locations and wildlife exploration.

All Gear Provided: No need to bring your own equipment—clear kayaks, dry bags, and life jackets are included.

Safe and Enjoyable: Enjoy a secure experiencer all ages with all necessary safety gear.

Wildlife Sightings: Experience a location known for sightings of both monkeys and manatees.
